ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 80% low-intensity (black) coverage and 20% high-intensity (white) localized mottling and highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white mottling and contiguous fragmented blobs localized on the distal and medial sections of the left lobe; the right lobe is predominantly a solid dark mass with minimal high-intensity pixel variance near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 30 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 1/8th of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes; the left lobe displays deeper, more jagged peaks compared to the slightly more rhythmic serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature fitted to the superior boundaries of both lobes, tapering toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle-type scarring) concentrated on the far left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal dark linear disruptions visible within the high-intensity white regions on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular serrations along the trailing edge and dense white encrustation/scarring on the left distal tip.
